name: Tripo: Import Model
description: TripoImportModelNode — Import an external 3D model (e.g. from Rodin, Hunyuan3D or a local file) into Tripo to use it with Tripo's post-processing nodes: Texture, Rig, Convert. GLB is recommended: textures survive import only when embedded in the file. Note that texturing an imported model requires a texture prompt.
